source_text: lim-gesihþ physical vision, sight by means of the bodily eye (? cf. A man has na lym þat he is warere wiþ þan wiþ his eghe, Hamp. Ps. 16, 9. Þe lyme of sy&yogh;te organum visus, N. E. D. under limb; I) :-- Ealle menn árísað mid limgesihðum (corporibus), Ps. Rdr. 301, 4.
